# Everlasting Destiny

> Frank Reyes, spiritual teacher and author of The Book of Everlasting Destiny. Everlasting Destiny is a calm, grounded place to begin your spiritual journey. On the ZCapitan YouTube channel you will find guided meditations, plus Shorts on the chakras, starseeds and the angelic orders, shared simply and with an open heart.

## Pages

- [Home](https://everlastingdestiny.com/): Overview of the book, the ZCapitan YouTube channel, The Hallway and the F.A.R. music project
- [Books](https://everlastingdestiny.com/books.html): The Book of Everlasting Destiny by Frank Reyes, thirteen chapters distilled from letters he wrote to the people he loves. The Hallway is a daily companion to this book, coming soon. Before Destiny, a personal prequel, is in progress.
- [Watch](https://everlastingdestiny.com/watch.html): Guided meditations and Shorts from the ZCapitan YouTube channel
- [Listen](https://everlastingdestiny.com/listen.html): F.A.R. music by Frank Reyes. We Were Made of Dawn is out now, Unlocked is a single, and Into the Tide of Light is out now
- [The Hallway](https://everlastingdestiny.com/destiny-app.html): A daily companion to The Book of Everlasting Destiny, coming soon
- [About](https://everlastingdestiny.com/about.html): Frank Reyes, spiritual teacher and author of The Book of Everlasting Destiny
